title: Haji Inam Elahi Asar
description: Founder & Honorary Project Director of Hijaz Hospital — biography and leadership roles.
name: Haji Inam Elahi Asar
biography: Haji Inam Elahi Asar was born on 15 October 1927 in Chiniot, Pakistan. After completing his matriculation, he began his professional career in Kolkata before returning to Pakistan in 1947. He established his business in Karachi and later moved to Lahore in 1953, where he built a successful business while dedicating his life to humanitarian and welfare work.

Inspired by the teachings and noble character of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ), Haji Inam Elahi Asar believed that serving humanity was one of the highest forms of worship. His integrity, generosity, and commitment to social welfare earned him recognition as one of Pakistan's leading businessmen and among the country's highest taxpayers during the peak of his career.

His enduring legacy is Hijaz Hospital, a charitable healthcare institution founded on the principles of compassion, dignity, and service. In a remarkable act of selflessness, he donated virtually all of his personal assets—including his residence—to support the hospital's mission.

In addition to Hijaz Hospital, Haji Inam Elahi Asar served numerous educational, healthcare, and welfare organizations across Pakistan, reflecting his lifelong commitment to community development and public service.
His vision and values continue to guide Hijaz Hospital's mission of delivering compassionate, accessible, and quality healthcare.
roles: Founder & Honorary Project Director, Hijaz Hospital
Executive Member & Former President, Chiniot Sheikh Association
Lifetime Member, Isha Haroon Hospital, Gulab Devi Hospital, and The Trust School
Finance Secretary, Government Dr. Maqbool Hospital

tribute.quote: May Almighty Allah (SWT) bless him with eternal peace and reward his lifelong service to humanity. Ameen.
